\title{Covariant derivatives and Wannier interpolation scheme}
\author{Jiayu Li}

\maketitle
Ref: arXiv:2303.10129

All the primed indices are assumed to be summed. $n,m$ are summed
over set $A$, and $p,l$ are summed over set $B$. 

Under 
\[
|n\rangle\stackrel{U^{A}}{\longrightarrow}\sum_{m}^{A}|m\rangle U_{mn}^{A},\ |l\rangle\stackrel{U^{B}}{\longrightarrow}\sum_{p}^{B}|p\rangle U_{pl}^{B}
\]
$X_{nl}=\langle n|\hat{X}|l\rangle$ is covariant transformed as
\[
X_{nl}\stackrel{U^{A}}{\longrightarrow}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(U^{A}\right)_{nm}^{\dagger}X_{ml},\ X_{nl}\stackrel{U^{B}}{\longrightarrow}\sum_{p}^{B}X_{mp}U_{pl}^{B}
\]
Yet, the derivative $X_{nl}^{,d}\equiv\langle n|\partial_{d}\hat{X}|l\rangle$
is not covariant transformed. 

We can define the covariant derivative 
\[
X_{nl}^{:d}\equiv\partial_{d}X_{nl}+D_{nn^{\prime}}^{d}X_{n^{\prime}l}-X_{nl^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}l}^{d}
\]
Matrix element
\begin{equation}
X_{nl}^{:d}=X_{nl}^{,d}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{d}X_{l^{\prime}l}+X_{nn^{\prime}}D_{n^{\prime}l}^{d}
\end{equation}
\begin{equation}
X_{nm}^{:d}=X_{nm}^{,d}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{d}X_{l^{\prime}m}+X_{nl^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{d}
\end{equation}
Hamiltonian 
\begin{equation}
H_{nm}^{:d}=H_{nm}^{,d},\ H_{nl}^{:d}=0
\end{equation}
Trace rule
\begin{equation}
\partial_{d}X_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}=X_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{:d}
\end{equation}
Product rule 
\begin{equation}
\left(X_{rs^{\prime}}Y_{s^{\prime}t}\right)^{:d}=X_{rs^{\prime}}^{:d}Y_{s^{\prime}t}+X_{rs^{\prime}}Y_{s^{\prime}t}^{:d}
\end{equation}
Chain rule 
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{f}_{ij}=\delta_{ij}f\left(\epsilon_{i}\right)
\end{equation}
\[
\widetilde{f}_{ij}^{:d}=H_{ij}^{:d}\times\begin{cases}
\frac{df\left(\epsilon\right)}{d\epsilon} & \mathrm{if}\ \epsilon_{i}=\epsilon_{j}\\
\frac{f\left(\epsilon_{i}\right)-f\left(\epsilon_{j}\right)}{\epsilon_{i}-\epsilon_{j}} & \mathrm{if}\ \epsilon_{i}\neq\epsilon_{j}
\end{cases}
\]


\section{Gauge-covariant matrices}

Let $P=\sum_{n}^{A}|u_{n}\rangle\langle u_{n}|$ and $Q=1-P$. The
states $|u_{n}\rangle$ are not necessary the eigenstates of energy,
and 
\begin{equation}
\mathcal{H}_{mn}=\langle u_{m}|\mathcal{H}|u_{n}\rangle
\end{equation}
is not necessary diagonal. We write four gauge-covariant quantities
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{equation}
\begin{align}
\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab} & =\frac{1}{2}\langle u_{m}|\mathcal{H}\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)+\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\mathcal{H}|u_{n}\rangle\nonumber \\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathcal{H}_{mn^{\prime}}\widetilde{F}_{n^{\prime}n}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{mn^{\prime}}^{ab}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n}\right)
\end{align}
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\mathcal{H}Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{H}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
\widetilde{S}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{\hbar^{2}}{m}\delta_{ab}\delta_{mn}+2\left(\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab}-\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}\right)
\end{equation}
The four matrices $\widetilde{O}_{mn}^{ab}$ are Hermitian in the
sence that $\widetilde{O}_{mn}^{ab}=\left(\widetilde{O}_{nm}^{ba}\right)^{*}$.
They transform covariantly under gauge transformation $|u_{n}\rangle\rightarrow|u_{n}^{\prime}\rangle=\sum_{m}^{A}|u_{m}\rangle U_{mn}$
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{O}^{ab}\rightarrow U^{\dagger}\widetilde{O}^{ab}U
\end{equation}

\noindent\fcolorbox{black}{white}{\begin{minipage}[t]{1\columnwidth - 2\fboxsep - 2\fboxrule}%
\textcolor{blue}{Quick note: }
\begin{eqnarray*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab} & = & \langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & = & \langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & = & \langle u_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\underset{0}{\underbrace{\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|Q}}|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|u_{n}\rangle+\langle u_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\underset{0}{\underbrace{\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|Q|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle}}\langle\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|u_{n}\rangle\\
 &  & +\langle u_{m}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle\partial_{a}u_{n^{\prime}}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|u_{n}\rangle+\langle u_{m}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle\partial_{a}u_{n^{\prime}}|\underset{0}{\underbrace{Q|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle}}|\langle\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & = & \langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & = & \langle\partial_{b}u_{n}|Q|\partial_{a}u_{m}\rangle^{*}=\left(\widetilde{F}_{nm}^{ba}\right)^{*}
\end{eqnarray*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab} & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & \rightarrow\left(\partial_{a}U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\right)\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|Q|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\left(\partial_{b}U_{n^{\prime}n}\right)+U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m^{\prime}}|Q|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\left(\partial_{b}U_{n^{\prime}n}\right)\\
 & +\left(\partial_{a}U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\right)\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle U_{n^{\prime}n}+U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m^{\prime}}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle U_{n^{\prime}n}\\
 & =U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m^{\prime}}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle U_{n^{\prime}n}=U_{mm^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\widetilde{F}_{m^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{ab}U_{n^{\prime}n}
\end{align*}
%
\end{minipage}}$\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{bc}$ is the covariant quantum geometry matrix,
$\widetilde{g}_{mn}^{bc}$ and $\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn}^{a}$ are
the covariant quantum metric and Berry curvature matrix, respectively
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{g}_{mn}^{bc} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{bc}+\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{cb}\right),\\
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn}^{a} & =i\epsilon_{abc}\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{bc}.
\end{align*}


\section{Wannier interpolation of quantum geometry}

\subsection{Convention}

Given the Wannier functions (WFs) $|\mathbf{R}j\rangle$, the Hamiltonian
written in real space is 
\begin{equation}
\mathcal{H}_{ij}^{W}\left(\mathbf{R}\right)=\langle\mathbf{0}i|\hat{\mathcal{H}}|\mathbf{R}j\rangle
\end{equation}
which can be transformed in reciprocal space as

\begin{equation}
\mathcal{H}_{ij}^{W}\left(\mathbf{k}\right)=\sum_{\mathbf{R}}e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot\left(\mathbf{R}+\mathbf{t}_{j}-\mathbf{t}_{i}\right)}\mathcal{H}_{ij}^{W}\left(\mathbf{R}\right)
\end{equation}
The eigenequation of $\mathcal{H}_{ij}^{W}\left(\mathbf{k}\right)$
\begin{equation}
\mathcal{H}^{W}\left(\mathbf{k}\right)U_{\mathbf{k}}=U_{\mathbf{k}}\varepsilon_{\mathbf{k}}
\end{equation}
reproduces the energy bands obtained from DFT calculations. The column
vectors $|n\rangle$ of $U_{\mathbf{k}}$ transform $|u_{j}^{W}\rangle$
into the eigenstates $|u_{j}\rangle$ with eigenenergy $\varepsilon_{j}$
\begin{equation}
|u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle=|u_{j^{\prime}\mathbf{k}}^{W}\rangle U_{\mathbf{k},j^{\prime}j}
\end{equation}
where 
\begin{equation}
|u_{j\mathbf{k}}^{W}\rangle=\sum_{\mathbf{R}}e^{i\mathbf{k}\cdot\left(\mathbf{R}+\mathbf{t}_{j}-\mathbf{r}\right)}|\mathbf{R}j\rangle
\end{equation}
is the Bloch-like function constructed by WFs. 

The derivative of states $|n\rangle$ yields 
\begin{equation}
D_{ln}^{a}=\langle l|\partial_{a}n\rangle=\begin{cases}
\frac{\langle\langle l||\partial_{a}\mathcal{H}^{W}||n\rangle\rangle}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l}} & \mathrm{if}\ l\neq n\\
-i\alpha_{n} & \mathrm{if}\ l=n
\end{cases}
\end{equation}
with $\alpha_{n}$ the arbitrary real number from the non-uniform
gauge. 
\[
\left(D_{nl}^{a}\right)^{*}=\langle n|\partial_{a}l\rangle^{*}=\langle\partial_{a}l|n\rangle=-\langle l|\partial_{a}n\rangle=D_{ln}^{a},\ \left(D_{ll}^{a}\right)^{*}=-D_{ll}^{a}
\]
yielding that $D^{a}$ is anti-Hermitian. Notice that $D^{a}=U^{\dagger}\partial_{a}U$,
we have 
\begin{align*}
|\partial_{a}u_{\mathbf{k}}\rangle & =|\partial_{a}u_{\mathbf{k}}^{W}\rangle U_{\mathbf{k}}+|u_{\mathbf{k}}^{W}\rangle U_{\mathbf{k}}U_{\mathbf{k}}^{\dagger}\partial_{a}U_{\mathbf{k}}\\
 & =|\partial_{a}u_{\mathbf{k}}^{W}\rangle U_{\mathbf{k}}+|u_{\mathbf{k}}\rangle D^{a}
\end{align*}

Berry curvature of sector A 
\[
\Omega_{A}^{ab}=-2{\rm Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n\bm{k}}|\partial_{b}u_{n\bm{k}}\rangle
\]
can be written with WFs as 
\begin{eqnarray*}
\langle\partial_{a}u_{\bm{k}}|\partial_{b}u_{\bm{k}}\rangle & = & \left(U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|+D^{a\dagger}\langle u|\right)\left(|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+|u\rangle D^{b}\right)\\
 & = & U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+D^{a\dagger}\langle u|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|u\rangle D^{b}+D^{a\dagger}D^{b}\\
 & = & U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+D^{a\dagger}U^{\dagger}\langle u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|u^{W}\rangle UD^{b}-D^{a}D^{b}\\
 & = & U^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+iD^{a}U^{\dagger}i\langle u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle U+iU^{\dagger}i\langle u^{W}|\partial_{a}u^{W}\rangle UD^{b}-D^{a}D^{b}
\end{eqnarray*}
Defining 
\[
\bar{O}=U^{\dagger}O^{W}U
\]
\[
F^{ab,W}=\langle\partial_{a}u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle
\]
\[
A^{b,W}=i\langle u^{W}|\partial_{b}u^{W}\rangle
\]
we have 
\begin{align*}
\Omega_{A}^{ab} & =-2{\rm Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\Omega_{nn}^{ab}\\
 & =-2{\rm Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\left[\bar{F}_{nn}^{ab}+i\left(D^{a}\bar{A}^{b}\right)_{nn}+i\left(\bar{A}^{a}D^{b}\right)_{nn}-\left(D^{a}D^{b}\right)_{nn}\right]
\end{align*}
Since that 
\begin{align*}
-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}i\left(D^{a}\bar{A}^{b}+\bar{A}^{a}D^{b}\right)_{nn} & =-2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{j}\left(D_{nj}^{a}\bar{A}_{jn}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nj}^{a}D_{jn}^{b}\right)\\
 & =-2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(D_{nm}^{a}\bar{A}_{mn}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}\right)\\
 & -2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}\left(D_{nl}^{a}\bar{A}_{ln}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\right)\\
 & =-\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(D_{nm}^{a}\bar{A}_{mn}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}+D_{nm}^{a*}\bar{A}_{mn}^{b*}+\bar{A}_{nm}^{a*}D_{mn}^{b*}\right)\\
 & -2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}\left(D_{nl}^{a}\bar{A}_{ln}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\right)\\
 & =-\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(D_{nm}^{a}\bar{A}_{mn}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}-D_{mn}^{a}\bar{A}_{nm}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn}^{a}D_{nm}^{b}\right)\\
 & -2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}\left(D_{nl}^{a}\bar{A}_{ln}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\right)\\
 & =-2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}\left(D_{nl}^{a}\bar{A}_{ln}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\right)
\end{align*}
and
\begin{align*}
-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\left(D^{a}D^{b}\right)_{nn} & =-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{j}D_{nj}^{a}D_{jn}^{b}\\
 & =-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}D_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}D_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\\
 & =i\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(D_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}-D_{nm}^{a*}D_{mn}^{b*}\right)-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}D_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\\
 & =i\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{m}^{A}\left(D_{nm}^{a}D_{mn}^{b}-D_{mn}^{a}D_{nm}^{b}\right)-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}D_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\\
 & =-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}D_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}
\end{align*}
 We have 
\[
\Omega_{A}^{ab}=\Omega_{A,\text{int}}^{ab}+\Omega_{A,\text{int}}^{ab}
\]
where 
\[
\Omega_{A,\text{int}}^{ab}=-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}D_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}
\]
\[
\Omega_{A,\text{ext}}^{ab}=-2\mathrm{Im}\sum_{n}^{A}\bar{F}_{nn}^{ab}-2\mathrm{Re}\sum_{n}^{A}\sum_{l}^{B}\left(D_{nl}^{a}\bar{A}_{ln}^{b}+\bar{A}_{nl}^{a}D_{ln}^{b}\right)
\]


\subsection{Wannier interpolation of $\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}$}

Recalling that $Q=1-|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|$,
we obtain
\begin{align}
Q|\partial_{a}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle & =Q|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+Q|u_{j^{\prime}}\rangle D_{j^{\prime}j}^{a}\nonumber \\
 & =|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}-|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\nonumber \\
 & =|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle U_{n^{\prime}j^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}i\langle u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\nonumber \\
 & =|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}j}^{a}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}
\end{align}
Therefore, we have 
\begin{align}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab} & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|QQ|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\nonumber \\
 & =\left(U_{j^{\prime\prime}m}^{*}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|-i\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|+D_{l^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\right)\left(|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\nonumber \\
 & =U_{mj^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}+\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\nonumber \\
 & +iU_{mj^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}+U_{mj^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}\nonumber \\
 & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\nonumber \\
 & =-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\nonumber \\
 & =-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+\left[\left(iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)+\left(\begin{array}{c}
a\leftrightarrow b\\
m\leftrightarrow n
\end{array}\right)^{*}\right]\nonumber \\
 & =\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab}
\end{align}
where 
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab} & =-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\\
\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab} & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+\left[\left(iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)+\left(\begin{array}{c}
a\leftrightarrow b\\
m\leftrightarrow n
\end{array}\right)^{*}\right]
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{Berry curvature}

The Berry curvature is computed as 
\begin{eqnarray*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn}^{z} & = & i\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{xy}-\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{yz}\right)\\
 & = & i\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}\right)\\
 &  & +i\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{xy}-\bar{F}_{mn}^{yx}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}-iD_{nl^{\prime}}^{y*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{x*}+\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}+iD_{nl^{\prime}}^{x*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{y*}\right)\\
 & = & -i\left(D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}\right)\\
 &  & +i\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{xy}-\bar{F}_{mn}^{yx}\right)+\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{x*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{y*}+D_{nl^{\prime}}^{y*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{x*}\right)\\
 &  & +i\left(-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y}+\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x}\right)\\
 & = & \left(-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}\right)\\
 &  & +\left(i\bar{F}_{mn}^{xy}-i\bar{F}_{mn}^{yx}\right)+\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{x*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{y*}+D_{nl^{\prime}}^{y*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{x*}\right)\\
 &  & +\left(-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x}\right)
\end{eqnarray*}
By writing 
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\omega}_{mn}^{z} & =-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+\frac{1}{2}\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y}\\
\left(\widetilde{\omega}^{z}\right)_{nm}^{*} & =iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}+\frac{1}{2}\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{x*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{y*}+D_{nl^{\prime}}^{y*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{x*}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x}
\end{align*}
we find that 
\[
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn}^{z}=\widetilde{\omega}_{mn}^{z}+\left(\widetilde{\omega}^{z}\right)_{nm}^{*}
\]
which is the code implement of Berry curvature in WannierBerri.

\subsubsection{Quantum metric}

We consider the quantum metric tensor 
\[
\widetilde{g}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ba}\right)
\]
where 
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab} & =\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ab}\\
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ab} & =-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\\
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ab} & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}
\end{align*}
Notice that 
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{nm,{\rm int}}^{ab*} & =-\left(D_{nl^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b}\right)^{*}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}=\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ba}\\
\widetilde{F}_{nm,{\rm ext}}^{ab*} & =\bar{F}_{nm}^{ab*}-\bar{A}_{nn^{\prime\prime}}^{a*}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}m}^{b*}-iD_{nl^{\prime\prime}}^{a*}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime\prime}m}^{b*}-i\bar{A}_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}\\
 & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ba}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{b}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{a}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{b}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}\\
 & =\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ba}
\end{align*}
Hence, 
\[
g_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{nm}^{ab*}\right)
\]


\subsubsection{Berry connection polarizability}

We consider the Berry connection polarizability (BCP)
\[
\mathcal{G}_{m}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\sum_{l\left(\ne m\right)}\frac{A_{ml}^{a}A_{lm}^{b}+A_{ml}^{b}A_{lm}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l}}
\]
To calculate BCP, we consider the band normalized quantum geometry
tensor 
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\]
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\mathcal{Q}_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\]
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\left(\mathcal{Q}_{m}+\mathcal{Q}_{n}\right)|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\]
where 
\[
\mathcal{Q}_{m}=\frac{|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}
\]
\begin{align*}
|\partial_{a}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle & =|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+|u_{j^{\prime}}\rangle D_{j^{\prime}j}^{a}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\mathcal{Q}_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|u_{j^{\prime}}\rangle D_{j^{\prime}j}^{a}\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle U_{l^{\prime}j^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\\
 & =-i\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}+\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(-i|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\right)
\end{align*}
\[
\mathcal{Q}_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle=\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(-i|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}\right)
\]
\[
Q|\partial_{b}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle=|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}j}^{b}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{b}
\]
\[
\mathcal{Q}_{m}Q=\frac{|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|=\frac{|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}=\mathcal{Q}_{m}
\]
\begin{align*}
\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\mathcal{Q}_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\mathcal{Q}_{m}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(i\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|+D_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\right)\left(|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(i\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}-\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & +\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(D_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}n}+iD_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}+D_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\left(\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & =\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\mathcal{Q}_{n}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{Q}_{n}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\left(U_{j^{\prime\prime}m}^{*}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|-i\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|+D_{l^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\right)\left(-i|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
 & =\left(-U_{j^{\prime\prime}m}^{*}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}|i|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-iD_{l^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}||u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & +\left(U_{j^{\prime\prime}m}^{*}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}||u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-i\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{n^{\prime\prime}}||u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+D_{l^{\prime\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}||u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
 & =\left(\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
 & =-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}-i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}
\end{align*}
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mm}^{ab}=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|\mathcal{Q}_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{m}\rangle=\sum_{l\left(\ne m\right)}\frac{A_{ml}^{a}A_{lm}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l}}
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & +\frac{1}{2}\left(-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}-i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}+i\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\right)\left(\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & -\frac{1}{2}\left(\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\right)\left(\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{n}}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & =\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\\
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a*} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a*}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a*}\\
 & =\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a}+iD_{l^{\prime}m}^{a}\\
 & =M_{l^{\prime}m}^{a}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}=\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a*} & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a*}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
 & =\frac{M_{l^{\prime}m}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
 & =-N_{l^{\prime}m}^{a}
\end{align*}
Noting that
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{nm}^{ab*} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\bar{A}_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}-i\frac{\bar{A}_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}-i\frac{D_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}-\frac{D_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}\right)\\
 & +\frac{1}{2}\left(-\bar{A}_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}+iD_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}+i\bar{A}_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}+D_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\frac{\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\frac{D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\right)\\
 & +\frac{1}{2}\left(-\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}-i\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}-i\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}+\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}}{\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}\right)\\
 & =\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ba}
\end{align*}
Hence, we can calculate $\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{mn}^{ab}$ through
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\text{Re}\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{nm}^{ab*}\right)
\]


\subsection{Covariant derivatives of $\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}$}

Now we derive the derivatives of $\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}$. Using
the product rule we have 
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{F}_{mn,\mathrm{int}}^{ab:d}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{b*}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d*}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-\left(\begin{array}{c}
a\leftrightarrow b\\
m\leftrightarrow n
\end{array}\right)^{*}
\end{equation}
We note that 
\[
\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ln}^{,b}=D_{ln^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}-\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ll^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}
\]
with $U_{\bm{k}}^{\dagger}\mathcal{H}^{W}\left(\mathbf{k}\right)U_{\mathbf{k}}=\varepsilon_{\mathbf{k}}=\bar{\mathcal{H}}$.
We take the covariant derivative of both side by using the product
rule 
\begin{align*}
D_{ln^{\prime}}^{b:d}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}+D_{ln^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}^{:d}-\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ll^{\prime}}^{:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ll^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d} & =\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ln}^{,b:d}\\
 & =\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ln}^{,bd}-D_{ln^{\prime}}^{d}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}^{,b}+\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ll^{\prime}}^{,b}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{d}
\end{align*}
In the Hamiltonian gauge 
\[
D_{ln}^{b:d}=\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{nl}}\left[\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ln}^{,bd}+\left(\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{ll^{\prime}}^{,b}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{d}-D_{ln^{\prime}}^{d}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}^{,b}+\left(b\leftrightarrow d\right)\right)\right]
\]
Thus, we find
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{F}_{mn,\mathrm{int}}^{ab:d}=-\frac{D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{nl^{\prime}}}\left[\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{l^{\prime}n}^{,bd}+\left(\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{,b}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{d}-D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{d}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}^{,b}+\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{,d}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{\mathcal{H}}_{n^{\prime}n}^{,d}\right)\right]-\left(\begin{array}{c}
a\leftrightarrow b\\
m\leftrightarrow n
\end{array}\right)^{*}
\end{equation}
The external term reads
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab:d} & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\\
 & +iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{Berry curvature dipole}

The Berry curvature dipole tensor thus reads
\[
\partial_{d}\Omega_{A}^{c}=\sum_{n}^{A}\Omega_{nn}^{c:d}=\sum_{n}^{A}\widetilde{\Omega}_{nn}^{c:d}=i\epsilon_{cab}\sum_{n}^{A}\widetilde{F}_{nn}^{ab:d}
\]
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ab:d}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}
\]
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ab:d}=\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}
\]
\[
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{int}}^{c:d}=i\epsilon_{abc}\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)
\]
\[
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{c:d}=i\epsilon_{abc}\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{int}}^{z:d} & =i\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\right)\\
 & =-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}\\
 & =-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}
\[
\left(-iD_{nl^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{y}+iD_{nl^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{x}\right)^{*}=-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{z:d} & =\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z:d}\\
 & -i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\\
 & -D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\\
 & -\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z:d}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\\
 & +\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{Quantum metric dipole}

\[
\partial_{d}g_{A}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\sum_{n}^{A}\left(\widetilde{F}_{nn}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{F}_{nn}^{ba:d}\right)
\]
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ab:d}=-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}
\]
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ab:d}=\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}
\]
\begin{align*}
\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm int}}^{ba:d}\right) & =\frac{1}{2}\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a:d}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)+\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{F}_{mn,{\rm ext}}^{ba:d}\right) & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}+\bar{F}_{mn}^{ba:d}\right)\\
 & +i\frac{1}{2}D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{1}{2}D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}+i\frac{1}{2}D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\frac{1}{2}D_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{a:d}\\
 & +i\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}+i\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{a:d}\\
 & -\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{b:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{a}-\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-\frac{1}{2}\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{b}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{a:d}\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)\\
 & +\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{Berry connection polarizability}

\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\right)
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}=\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}
\end{align*}
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{mn}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ba}\right)
\]
\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:d}=\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)
\]
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\\
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d*} & =\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}+iD_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}\\
 & =M_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d} & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}=\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d*} & =-N_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{mn}^{ab:d} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ba:d}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)\\
 & +\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{nm}^{ab:d}\right)^{*} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{nl^{\prime}}^{a:d}M_{l^{\prime}m}^{b}+N_{nl^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}m}^{b:d}-M_{nl^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}m}^{b}-M_{nl^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}m}^{b:d}\right)^{*}\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{nl^{\prime}}^{a:d*}M_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}+N_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}M_{l^{\prime}m}^{b:d*}-M_{nl^{\prime}}^{a:d*}N_{l^{\prime}m}^{b*}-M_{nl^{\prime}}^{a*}N_{l^{\prime}m}^{b:d*}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{a:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{b:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{a}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{b}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{a:d}\right)\\
 & =\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ba:d}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{G}}_{mn}^{ab:d} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ba:d}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{nm}^{ab:d*}\right)
\end{align*}

\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab} & =\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab}+\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab}
\end{align*}


\subsection{Second order derivative of quantum geometry tensor}

We first derive the second order derivative of $\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}$.
With $\widetilde{F}_{mn,\mathrm{int}}^{ab:d}$ obtained, we can write
down the second order covariant derivative of $\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}$
by 
\[
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab:de}=\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}\right)^{:e}=\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab:d}\right)^{:e}+\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab:d}\right)^{:e}
\]
For the internal term
\begin{align*}
\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab:d}\right)^{:e} & =\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)^{:e}\\
 & =-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:e}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:de}
\end{align*}
For the external term
\begin{align*}
\left(\widetilde{F}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab:d}\right)^{:e} & =\left(\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)^{:e}\\
 & =\bar{F}_{mn}^{ab:de}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d:e}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:e}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a:e}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b:de}\\
 & +iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:e}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:de}\\
 & +i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:e}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+i\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:de}
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{Berry curvature quadrupole}

\[
\partial_{e}\partial_{d}\Omega_{A}^{c}=\sum_{n}^{A}\widetilde{\Omega}_{nn}^{c:de}=i\epsilon_{cab}\sum_{n}^{A}\widetilde{F}_{nn}^{ab:de}
\]

\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{int}}^{z:d} & =i\left(-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\right)\\
 & =-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:d}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x}\\
 & =-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}
\[
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{int}}^{z:de}=-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:de}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:de}+\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{z:d} & =\frac{1}{2}\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z:d}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}\\
 & +\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\Omega}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{z:de} & =\frac{1}{2}\bar{\Omega}_{mn}^{z:de}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x:e}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y:d}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{y:de}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y:e}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{x:de}\\
 & -D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:e}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:de}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:e}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+D_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}\bar{A}_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:de}\\
 & -\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:d}-\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{x}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{y:de}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y:e}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:d}+\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{y}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{x:de}+\left(m\leftrightarrow n\right)^{*}
\end{align*}


\subsubsection{BCP}

\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:d}=\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}\right)
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{mn}^{ab:de} & =\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:e}\right.\\
 & +N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}+N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:de}\\
 & -M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:e}\\
 & \left.-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:d}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n}^{b:de}\right)
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\frac{\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}=\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\\
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d*} & =M_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}
\end{align*}
\[
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}=\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}
\]
\begin{align*}
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d} & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}\\
 & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d*} & =-N_{l^{\prime}m}^{a:d}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de} & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\frac{v_{m}^{e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{e}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}\\
 & -M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}+2M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\left(v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}\right)\left(v_{m}^{e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{e}\right)}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{3}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d:e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d:e}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}\\
 & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}-\left(\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}\right)\frac{v_{m}^{e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{e}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}+M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{\left(v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}\right)\left(v_{m}^{e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{e}\right)}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{3}}-M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d:e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d:e}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)^{2}}\\
 & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:de}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:e}\frac{v_{m}^{d}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a:d}\frac{v_{m}^{e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{e}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}-N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\frac{v_{m}^{d:e}-v_{l^{\prime}}^{d:e}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}
\end{align*}


\subsection{Orbital magnetic quadrupole}

\subsubsection{Orbital magnetization}

We first review the construction of orbital magnetization (dipole
moment). In the framework of covariant matrix, the orbital magnetization
matrix is given by 
\[
\frac{2\hbar}{e}\widetilde{M}_{mn}^{c}=-i\epsilon_{cab}\left(\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab}-2\mu\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}\right)
\]
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{equation}
\begin{align}
\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab} & =\frac{1}{2}\langle u_{m}|\mathcal{H}\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)+\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\mathcal{H}|u_{n}\rangle\nonumber \\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left(\mathcal{H}_{mn^{\prime}}\widetilde{F}_{n^{\prime}n}^{ab}+\widetilde{F}_{mn^{\prime}}^{ab}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n}\right)
\end{align}
\begin{equation}
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\mathcal{H}Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{H}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{equation}
To see this relation, we consider the orbital magnetic moment at zero
temperature
\begin{align*}
M^{c} & =-\frac{e}{2\hbar}i\epsilon_{cab}\sum_{n\in\text{occ},\bm{k}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{n\in\text{occ},\bm{k}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\sum_{m}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\left(\sum_{m\in\text{occ}}+\sum_{m\in\text{unocc}}\right)\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
If $m\in\text{occ}$
\begin{align*}
 & \epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{n,m\in\text{occ}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
= & \epsilon_{cab}\sum_{n,m\in\text{occ}}\left(\varepsilon_{n}+\varepsilon_{m}-2\mu\right)\text{Im}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
The integrand is symmetric under $a\leftrightarrow b$, as 
\begin{align*}
 & \sum_{n,m\in\text{occ}}\left(\varepsilon_{n}+\varepsilon_{m}-2\mu\right)\text{Im}\langle\partial_{b}u_{n}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{n}\rangle\\
= & \sum_{n,m\in\text{occ}}\left(\varepsilon_{n}+\varepsilon_{m}-2\mu\right)\text{Im}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|u_{n}\rangle\langle u_{n}|\partial_{b}u_{m}\rangle\\
= & \sum_{n,m\in\text{occ}}\left(\varepsilon_{n}+\varepsilon_{m}-2\mu\right)\text{Im}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
Then the summation with $\epsilon_{cab}$ becomes zero. Therefore
\begin{align*}
M^{c} & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\sum_{m\in\text{unocc}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|\left(\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu\right)Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\text{Im}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\langle\partial_{a}u_{n}|Q\left(\varepsilon_{n}+H-2\mu\right)Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
Thus, we have 
\begin{align*}
 & -i\epsilon_{cab}\left(\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}+\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab}-2\mu\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab}\right)\\
= & -i\epsilon_{cab}\left(\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{H}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle+\frac{\varepsilon_{m}+\varepsilon_{n}}{2}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle-2\mu\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\right)\\
= & -i\epsilon_{cab}\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\left(\mathcal{H}+\frac{\varepsilon_{m}+\varepsilon_{n}}{2}-2\mu\right)Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
and $\sum_{\bm{k}}\widetilde{M}_{m^{\prime}m^{\prime}}^{c}=M^{c}$
is indeed the orbital magnetization. 

The implement of $\bm{M}_{\text{orb}}$ in WannierBerri is realized
through three functions. First, it calculates the covariant H matrix
\[
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab}=\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\mathcal{H}Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle=\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{H}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle
\]
Within the framework of Wannier Interpolation, we have already know
that 
\[
Q|\partial_{a}u_{j\mathbf{k}}\rangle=|\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime}j}+i|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}j}^{a}+|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime}j}^{a}
\]
Then 
\begin{eqnarray*}
\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\mathcal{H}Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle & = & \left(U_{j^{\prime}m}^{*}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|-i\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|+D_{l^{\prime}m}^{a*}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\right)\mathcal{H}\left(|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}+i|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\right)\\
 & = & U_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}+\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & +iU_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}\\
 &  & +U_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}\\
 &  & -i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\mathcal{H}|u_{n^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 & = & U_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}H_{j^{\prime}j}^{W,ab}U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}+\bar{A}_{mm^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{m^{\prime}n^{\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-2A_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\varepsilon_{n^{\prime\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & +iU_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime\prime}}\varepsilon_{n^{\prime\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\varepsilon_{n^{\prime}}U_{n^{\prime}j^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\langle u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}\\
 &  & -iU_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}i\langle\partial_{a}u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}U_{l^{\prime}j^{\prime}}^{\dagger}i\langle u_{j^{\prime}}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{b}u_{j^{\prime\prime}}^{W}\rangle U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}\\
 & = & \bar{H}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mm^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{m^{\prime}n^{\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & -\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime\prime}}^{a}\varepsilon_{n^{\prime\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}-i\bar{A}_{mn^{\prime}}^{a}\varepsilon_{n^{\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & +iU_{mj^{\prime}}^{\dagger}\left(B_{j^{\prime\prime}j^{\prime}}^{W,a}\right)^{*}U_{j^{\prime\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}U_{l^{\prime}j^{\prime}}^{\dagger}B_{j^{\prime}j^{\prime\prime}}^{W,b}U_{j^{\prime\prime}n}\\
 & = & \bar{H}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mm^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{m^{\prime}n^{\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & -iU_{j^{\prime}m}^{*}\left(B_{j^{\prime\prime}j^{\prime}}^{W,a}\right)^{*}\left(U_{l^{\prime\prime}j^{\prime\prime}}^{\dagger}\right)^{*}\left(D_{nl^{\prime\prime}}^{b}\right)^{*}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{B}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}\\
 & = & \bar{H}_{mn}^{ab}-\bar{A}_{mm^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{m^{\prime}n^{\prime}}\bar{A}_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}\\
 &  & +iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\bar{B}_{l^{\prime}n}^{b}-i\left(D_{nl^{\prime\prime}}^{b}\bar{B}_{l^{\prime\prime}m^{\prime}}^{W,a}\right)^{*}
\end{eqnarray*}
\begin{eqnarray*}
B_{ij}^{W,a} & = & i\langle u_{i}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{a}u_{j}^{W}\rangle\\
H_{ij}^{W,ab} & = & \langle\partial_{b}u_{i}^{W}|\mathcal{H}|\partial_{b}u_{j}^{W}\rangle
\end{eqnarray*}
Thus
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab} & =\widetilde{H}_{mn,\text{int}}^{ab}+\widetilde{H}_{mn,\text{ext}}^{ab}\\

\]
where $W_{n}^{lj}=\langle u_{n}|\partial_{l}\partial_{j}\mathcal{H}|u_{n}\rangle$.
It contains four distinct contributions. 
\[

\]
where 
\begin{align*}

M_{lk}^{\text{ME2}} & =-2\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\text{Re}A_{nm}^{l}M_{mn}^{k}}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}}\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\mu\right)\\
M_{lk}^{\text{W}} & =-\frac{1}{12}\epsilon_{ijk}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\partial_{i}W_{n}^{lj}\\
M_{lk}^{\text{QM}} & =-\frac{1}{3}\epsilon_{ijk}\sum_{\bm{k}}\sum_{n\in\text{occ}}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj}\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\mu\right)
\end{align*}

 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}v_{n}^{i}\langle u_{m}|i\partial_{j}u_{n}\rangle+\frac{e}{2\hbar}\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}\mathcal{H}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|i\partial_{j}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{e}{2\hbar}v_{n}^{i}A_{mn}^{j}+\frac{e}{2\hbar}\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}v_{mp}^{i}A_{pn}^{j}\\

\end{align*}

\[
\widetilde{M}_{mn}^{c:d}=-i\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\left(\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab:d}+\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab:d}-2\mu\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab:d}\right)
\]
\[
\widetilde{M}_{mn}^{c:d}=\widetilde{M}_{mn}^{c,d}-D_{ml^{\prime}}^{d}\widetilde{M}_{l^{\prime}n}^{c}+\widetilde{M}_{ml^{\prime}}^{c}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{d}
\]
\[
\widetilde{M}_{mn}^{c,d}=-i\frac{e}{2\hbar}\epsilon_{cab}\left(\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab,d}+\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab,d}-2\mu\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab,d}\right)
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\langle u_{m}|\partial_{d}\left[\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\mathcal{H}Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\right]|u_{n}\rangle\\
\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\frac{1}{2}\langle u_{m}|\partial_{d}\left[\mathcal{H}\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)+\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\mathcal{H}\right]|u_{n}\rangle\\
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\langle u_{m}|\partial_{d}\left[\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\right]|u_{n}\rangle
\end{align*}
\[
D_{ml^{\prime}}^{d}\widetilde{M}_{l^{\prime}n}^{c}=
\]
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{H}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}|u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|\right)Q\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|Q\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)Q|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|u_{l^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime}}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{v_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}v_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{d}v_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}\right)}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{G}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\frac{1}{2}\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)+\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left[\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle+\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)Q\left(\partial_{b}P\right)\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{n}\rangle\right]\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left[\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)\left(\partial_{a}|u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|\right)|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\left(\partial_{b}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\right)|u_{n}\rangle+\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}|u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|\right)|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\left(\partial_{b}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\right)\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{n}\rangle\right]\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\left[\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle\partial_{a}u_{m^{\prime}}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle+\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\left(\partial_{d}\mathcal{H}\right)|u_{n}\rangle\right]\\
 & =\frac{1}{2}\frac{v_{mm^{\prime}}^{d}v_{m^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{a}v_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}+v_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}v_{l^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}v_{n^{\prime}n}^{d}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}\right)}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\widetilde{F}_{mn}^{ab,d} & =\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}P\right)\left(\partial_{d}Q\right)\left(\partial_{b}P\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\langle u_{m}|\left(\partial_{a}|u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|\right)\left(\partial_{d}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\right)\left(\partial_{b}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{n^{\prime}}|\right)|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\langle u_{m}|\partial_{a}u_{m^{\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{m^{\prime}}|\partial_{d}u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|\partial_{b}u_{n}\rangle+\langle\partial_{a}u_{m}|u_{l^{\prime\prime}}\rangle\langle\partial_{d}u_{l^{\prime\prime}}|u_{n^{\prime}}\rangle\langle\partial_{b}u_{n^{\prime}}|u_{n}\rangle\\
 & =\frac{v_{mm^{\prime}}^{a}v_{m^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{d}v_{l^{\prime\prime}n}^{b}}{\left(\varepsilon_{m^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m^{\prime}}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}\right)}-\frac{v_{ml^{\prime\prime}}^{a}v_{l^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{d}v_{n^{\prime}n}^{b}}{\left(\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}-\varepsilon_{m}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{n^{\prime}}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime\prime}}\right)\left(\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{n^{\prime}}\right)}
\end{align*}


\subsection{Calculation of $\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj}$}

\[
g_{n}^{lj}=\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}A_{nm}^{l}A_{mn}^{j}=\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj} & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\frac{\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right.\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\left.\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\partial_{i}\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right]\\
 & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right.\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -\left.2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]\\
 & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}\right.\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{mp}}\\
 & +\frac{\Gamma_{nm}^{il}\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\Gamma_{mn}^{ij}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -\left.2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{v_{n}^{i}-v_{m}^{i}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]\\
 & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{np}\mathbf{V}_{pm}^{l}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{mn}-\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{nm}\mathbf{V}_{mp}^{j}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{pn}\right.\\
 & -\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\mathbf{V}_{np}^{l}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{pm}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{mn}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{nm}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{mp}\mathbf{V}_{pn}^{j}\\
 & +\left(\bm{\Gamma}^{il}\right)_{nm}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{mn}+\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{nm}\left(\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}\right)_{mn}\\
 & +\left.2\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{nm}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{mn}\mathbf{V}_{n}^{i}-2\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right)_{nm}\mathbf{V}_{m}^{i}\left(\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right)_{mn}\right]
\end{align*}
\[
g_{n}^{lj}=\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}A_{nm}^{l}A_{mn}^{j}=\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj} & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right.\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -\left.2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\end{align*}
\[
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj}=\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{I}}+\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{II}}+\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{III}}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{I}} & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[-2\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\right.\\
 & -2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -6\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\left(\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}\right)\left(\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}\right)}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{4}}-2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & \left.-2\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}-2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{I}} & =2\left[\bm{\Gamma}^{il}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\right]\right]_{nn}-\left[\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{il}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]_{nn}\\
 & -2\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\left[\bm{\Gamma}^{ij},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\right]\right]_{nn}-\left[\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kl}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]_{nn}\\
 & -6\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left(\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}-\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}-\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\right)\right]_{nn}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{II}} & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[-2\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right.\\
 & -\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle\partial_{i}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{k}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{k}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle\partial_{k}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{k}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle\partial_{k}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{k}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\langle\partial_{k}u_{n}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & -2\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{k}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\\
 & \left.-2\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{k}u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\end{align*}

\begin{align*}
