\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{II}} & =\text{Re}\left[2\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{l}\right]\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k}\right]+2\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{k},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\right]\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]\right.\\
 & +2\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{l}\right]\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}},\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i}\right]+2\left[\mathbf{V}_{F}^{i},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{3}}\right]\left[\mathbf{V}^{j},\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon}\right]\\
 & +\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{kl}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kl}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]\\
 & +\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{il}\right]\frac{\mathbf{V}^{j}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}+\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{il}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{j}\right]\\
 & +\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}\right]+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{i}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{l}\right]\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{kj}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\\
 & \left.+\frac{\mathbf{V}^{l}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}\right]+\left[\frac{\mathbf{V}^{k}}{\Delta\varepsilon},\mathbf{V}^{l}\right]\frac{\bm{\Gamma}^{ij}}{\Delta\varepsilon^{2}}\right]
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{k}\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj,\text{III}} & =\\
\\\\
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{i}g_{n}^{lj} & =\text{Re}\sum_{m\left(\neq n\right)}\left[\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{i}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq n\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{i}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}\varepsilon_{np}}\right.\\
 & +\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|\partial_{i}u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\sum_{p\left(\neq m\right)}\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle\partial_{i}u_{m}|u_{p}\rangle\langle u_{p}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & +\frac{\langle u_{n}|\partial_{i}v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}+\frac{\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|\partial_{i}v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{2}}\\
 & -\left.2\langle u_{n}|v_{l}|u_{m}\rangle\langle u_{m}|v_{j}|u_{n}\rangle\frac{\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{n}-\partial_{i}\varepsilon_{m}}{\varepsilon_{nm}^{3}}\right]
\end{align*}


\subsection{Drude term}

\begin{align*}
X_{nm}^{:d} & =X_{nm}^{,d}+X_{nl^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}m}^{d}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{d}X_{l^{\prime}m}\\
X_{nl}^{:d} & =X_{nl}^{,d}+X_{nn^{\prime}}D_{n^{\prime}l}^{d}-D_{nl^{\prime}}^{d}X_{l^{\prime}l}\\
X_{ln}^{:d} & =X_{ln}^{,d}+X_{ll^{\prime}}D_{l^{\prime}n}^{d}-D_{ln^{\prime}}^{d}X_{n^{\prime}n}
\end{align*}
\[
\partial_{b}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}=\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:b}=\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}
\]
\begin{align*}
\partial_{c}\left(\partial_{b}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}\right) & =\partial_{c}\left(\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}\right)\\
 & =\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:c}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a:c}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b:c}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b:c}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:c}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\partial_{d}\left(\partial_{c}\left(\partial_{b}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}\right)\right) & =\partial_{d}\left(\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:c}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a:c}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b:c}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b:c}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:c}\right)\\
 & ={\color{red}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:cd}}+{\color{red}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a:cd}}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a:c}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b:d}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a:d}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b:c}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b:cd}\\
 & -D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b:cd}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b:c}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:d}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b:d}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:c}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{b}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:cd}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:cd} & =\left(\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:c}\right)^{:d}\\
 & =\left(\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,abc}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,ab}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{c}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab}\right)^{:d}\\
 & =\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,abc:d}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,ab:d}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c}+\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{,ab}D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c:d}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{c:d}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab}-D_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{c}\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ab:d}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:cd} & =\left(\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:c}\right)^{:d}\\
 & =\left(\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ac}+\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c}-D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime\prime}}^{c}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime\prime}}^{,a}\right)^{:d}\\
 & =\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,ac:d}+\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{,a:d}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c}+\mathcal{H}_{l^{\prime}l^{\prime\prime}}^{,a}D_{l^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{c:d}-D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime\prime}}^{c:d}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a}-D_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime\prime}}^{c}\mathcal{H}_{n^{\prime\prime}n^{\prime}}^{,a:d}
\end{align*}

\[
\widetilde{\mathcal{F}}_{n^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{ab}=\frac{1}{2}\left(N_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{a}M_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}-M_{n^{\prime}l^{\prime}}^{a}N_{l^{\prime}n^{\prime}}^{b}\right)
\]
\begin{align*}
M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\bar{A}_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}+iD_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}\\
N_{ml^{\prime}}^{a} & =\frac{M_{ml^{\prime}}^{a}}{\varepsilon_{m}-\varepsilon_{l^{\prime}}}
\end{align*}
\begin{align*}
\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{n} & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{n}}\\
\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{m} & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{m}}\\
G_{n}^{R}G_{m}^{R} & =\frac{1}{\left(\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{n}+i\eta\right)\left(\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{m}+i\eta\right)}\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{n}+i\eta}-\frac{1}{\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{m}+i\eta}\right)\\
 & =\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}}\left(G_{n}^{R}-G_{m}^{R}\right)\\
\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}} & =\frac{G_{n}^{R}G_{m}^{R}}{G_{n}^{R}-G_{m}^{R}}=\frac{1}{G_{m}^{R-1}-G_{n}^{R-1}}\\
\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{n}^{-1} & =\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{n}\\
\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{m}^{-1} & =\varepsilon-\varepsilon_{m}\\
\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{m}^{-1}-\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{n}^{-1} & =\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}\\
\frac{1}{\varepsilon_{n}-\varepsilon_{m}} & =\frac{1}{\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{m}^{-1}-\mathcal{\mathfrak{g}}_{n}^{-1}}
\end{align*}
